about_the_game:
Mewseum: Masterpieces is a relaxing game where you can solve hundreds of puzzles while revealing unique masterpieces. Unwind to the sound of a beautiful piano with classical music or listen to your own favorite audio while playing. The puzzles range from easy to medium difficulty, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free experience.

🧩How to Play:

Your task is to paint squares and/or rectangles within the grid while following two simple rules:

  • Each painted section must contain exactly one number.

  • The number indicates the exact size of the section you need to paint.

🎨Explore Art History… with Cats!

Discover reimagined versions of iconic paintings, where cats take center stage in some of the most famous artworks in history. The featured paintings include:
🦪Girl with a Pearl Earring
👩‍🎨Mona Lisa
🙀The Scream
✨Starry Night
🏡American Gothic
🦵Abaporu

🎮Features:

✔ Auto-save with Steam Cloud – pause and continue anytime.
✔ Over 10 hours of content: Become a true artist as you reveal stunning paintings by solving relaxing and immersive puzzles. Unlock over 60 achievements and complete your collection!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2 Ghz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting DirectX 9.0c
